exposure: Robson's Ten Group Classification System categories
outcome: distribution of C-sections across Robson's classification groups
cohort: The study participants were patients who delivered at King George Hospital, Visakhapatnam, between January and June 2023.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 61.78%, with Robson's Group 5 being the major contributor, followed by Group 2 and 1.
mod_finding: The study found a higher primary C-section rate than repeat C-section rate and recommended better patient selection for induction of labor in Group 2 and more encouragement of TOLACs in Group 5 to reduce C-section rates.
